decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the crossover is used.

Condition : 3 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 4 - The landscaping as detailed on the approved plans shall be maintained for a period of no less than 5 years from the date of full completion of the works and if any plant or flower is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies another of a similar species and the same size shall be planted in the same place.
description: Construction of vehicular crossover to front of dwellinghouse
